definitions.gloss: shorts reaching to about the knee
definitions.explanation: Shorts of roughly knee length, between ordinary trousers and short shorts, worn casually in summer and for sports.

examples.japanese: ハーフパンツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はく。

examples.english: In summer I wear knee-length shorts at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、Tシャツ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ハーフパンツ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: It was a hot day, so I went out in a T-shirt and knee-length shorts.

notes:
Made-in-Japan English ("half pants"). The length is what separates it from other words for shorts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{短|たん}パン→短パン：33896_tanpan⟧: shorts — informal, usually shorter
- ⟦ショートパンツ→ショートパンツ：33914_shootopantsu⟧: short shorts, hot pants
